verdict.rationale: Honeycomb documents an API and offers a downloadable OpenAPI spec for use 'with your own tooling.' That spec is a developer building block, not an interactive API reference with runnable examples, and no evidence shows a first-party try-it console or executable reference. The probe also found no OpenAPI spec at the standard candidate paths.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: You can [download the Honeycomb OpenAPI spec](/api/openapi-public.yaml) to use with your own tooling.
